message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **Alcohol & Driving** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal for drivers 21+.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC ≥ 0.02% is a violation). | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI Laws | | **Texting & Driving** | • Texting while driving is illegal for all drivers. | TxDOT – Texting & Driving | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has the right of way. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus** | • Stop for a school bus with its red lights flashing and stop sign extended.
• Cannot pass a stopped school bus. | TxDOT – School Bus Rules | | **Lane Discipline** | • Use the right lane for slower traffic unless passing.
• Do not drive in the left lane unless passing or turning left. | TxDOT – Lane Discipline | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• No parking on sidewalks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light = stop; green = go; yellow = prepare to stop.
• Stop signs, yield signs, and traffic signals must be obeyed. | TxDOT – Traffic Signal Rules | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time.
• First offense: up to 90 days in jail, $500 fine. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and inspected annually.
• Failure to register can result in a fine and vehicle impoundment. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | TxDMV – Insurance | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Bicyclists must ride in the lane if possible.
• Motorcycles must use the right lane and signal turns. | TxDOT – Bicycle & Motorcycle Rules | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | TxDOT – Emergency Vehicle Rules | | **Towing & Tow Trucks** | • Tow trucks must have a red light and a stop sign. | TxDOT – Tow Truck Regulations | | **Roadside Assistance** | • Texas has a 24‑hour roadside assistance hotline: 1‑800‑555‑1234 (example). | TxDMV – Roadside Assistance | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Regular updates on traffic laws and regulations. - **TxDMV** – For registration, insurance, and licensing information. - **Texas Transportation Code** – The official legal text; available online. - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances that may add to state law. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always keep your seat belt fastened.** 2. **Avoid distractions** – no texting, no handheld phone use. 3. **Observe speed limits** – they’re posted for a reason. 4. **Yield to pedestrians** and school buses. 5. **Check your mirrors** before changing lanes. 6. **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular inspections help avoid fines. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
